import { Content as GodotReadme } from "../../../../../../../sdks/godot/README.md";

The Godot SDK is a pure-GDScript addon (the engine has no Ed25519 or SHA-512, so it carries its
own) behind the `PolarisKey` autoload: install it from Polaris Key's Godot feed (the editor's
AssetLib tab, or GodotEnv), fill in the setup dock, and `await PolarisKey.boot()`. It runs on Godot 4.4
and later, 4.6 and later recommended, and passes the same conformance corpus as every other SDK,
in the editor and on an exported release template. This page renders `sdks/godot/README.md`
whole, so there is exactly one copy to keep current; the contributor notes are in
`sdks/godot/CONTRIBUTING.md`.
